# Vendored Maven artifacts

This directory contains immutable dependencies that are no longer reliably
available to clean CI runners from their original repository.

## FlexibleAdapter

- Coordinate: `com.github.arkon.FlexibleAdapter:flexible-adapter:c8013533`
- Source: https://github.com/arkon/FlexibleAdapter
- License: Apache License 2.0
- AAR SHA-256: `41929c785c249e0395faf89fd6bb253aafd65d44d88dbeaa46ecd9658d706cc4`

The artifact and its original JitPack POM are kept unchanged. The local Maven
repository is restricted to this group in `settings.gradle.kts`.
